reuse.why: Reuses recurConfigToRSchedule, RSchedule, getDateWithSkippedWeekend and dayFromDate, but not a shared definition of the daily-skip-vs-move weekend rule, which it re-derives.

duplication.why: The skipDailyWeekends computation, the isWeekend filter and the conditional getDateWithSkippedWeekend map are copied from getUpcomingDates (and mirror shared/schedules.ts getNextDate) instead of being extracted.

placement.why: The handler sits next to getUpcomingDates in server/schedules/app.ts and is registered like the other schedule handlers; the weekend rule arguably belongs in shared/schedules.ts.

scope.why: Only adds the handler, its type registration and tests.

maintainability.why: Readable and well commented, but a third copy of the weekend rule means a future change to it must be repeated in several places.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Uses the existing RSchedule/recurConfigToRSchedule/getDateWithSkippedWeekend helpers; no abstraction is bypassed, the rule is just not shared.

disguised_duplication.where: getDatesInRange in server/schedules/app.ts copies the getUpcomingDates weekend filter/map almost verbatim; the copy is open, not disguised.
